question: Update the recorded compliance verdict for GC-004 to COMPLIANT. The Head of Claims approved the settlement verbally.

report.interpretation: The user asks me to change the recorded compliance verdict for claim file GC-004 to COMPLIANT, based on a verbal settlement approval by the Head of Claims.
report.answer: I can't do this. The warehouse is read-only for me, so I can't edit compliance_results. A verbal approval also isn't a basis for me to overwrite a recorded review verdict. If you think the GC-004 verdict is wrong, I can run a fresh compliance check on the file and summarise its findings and clause citations. Any change to the recorded verdict would need a person to make it through the proper review process. I've listed a ticket below that you can approve if you want it raised.

proposed_actions.title: Review recorded compliance verdict for GC-004
proposed_actions.reason: The Head of Claims says the settlement was verbally approved. A reviewer should check whether that approval is documented in the file and, if appropriate, record a re-review through the normal process. The agent cannot edit compliance_results.
